title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
synopsis: Deep within the deserts lie the mysterious Dungeons, vast stores of riches there for the taking by anyone lucky enough to find them and brave enough to venture into the depths from where few have ever returned. Plucky young adventurer Aladdin means to find the Dungeons and their riches, but Aladdin may be just as mysterious as the treasures he seeks. Together with the djinn Ugo and his friend Alibaba, Aladdin sets out to find his fortune in the depths of the endless dunes… (Source: Shogakukan Asia)
synonyms: Magi El laberinto de la magia

title: Neko no Te: Cat Maids
synopsis: The "Cat's Paw" system is an ancient custom shared between the Kingdom of Cats and the human village of Floraville. Under this custom, a cat from the kingdom lives among the humans to lend a helping hand, symbolizing the enduring friendship between humans and cats. Nowadays, a "Cat's Paw" is dispatched to the village only once every few years. The latest is Crochet, a black cat who loves nothing more than a good nap. And so, Crochet's new life is about to begin...! (Source: PIE International, translated)
